title: [S-CONC-ACCEPT] finite versioned workload for reference equivalence, real Store concurrency, recovery and independent-scope Product progress
catalogue_note: Transitions bind operation_manifest_set_digest(&generated_operation_manifests()) at runtime on the Surreal path and the admitting single generated-manifest digest on the memory reference path; both digests must derive from this same frozen generated catalogue. The manifest-digest representation differs by backend contour and is the only normalized field in case 2.

queue_limits.note: Mirrors store_concurrency_profile.toml [execution]; corpus declares the denominator, the profile owns the numbers.

causal_partial_order: A+B/B+C multiscope claims share scope-994-b precedence from the single ORS coordinator; disjoint scopes carry no order edge.

cases.name: implementation_profile_operation_corpus_denominator
cases.expectation: Corpus declares exactly cases 1..20 once across both suites; profile carries all limits; catalogue digest computes and matches across suites.

cases.name: reference_versus_surreal_equivalence
cases.expectation: Identical immutable semantic operations replayed through memory reference and Surreal path yield equal semantic history; only manifest-digest representation and timing normalize.

cases.name: independent_scope_provider_overlap
cases.expectation: Two disjoint admitted operations overlap inside the provider seam (3-party barrier rendezvous) and both commit with valid heads and receipts.

cases.name: overlapping_scopes_consistently_ordered
cases.expectation: Overlapping operations serialize per scope with one consistent precedence; per-scope sequences advance monotonically.

cases.name: multiscope_claim_without_cyclic_wait
cases.expectation: A+B then B+C claims share scope-994-b precedence; both orders of arrival keep per-scope order consistent; no partial acquisition.

cases.name: concurrent_exact_replay_single_effect
cases.expectation: Exact concurrent replay yields one effect set and the original receipt; snapshot identical before and after replay.

cases.name: changed_same_operation_input_conflicts
cases.expectation: Same operation identity with changed input conflicts (IdentityConflict or digest mismatch) without mutation.

cases.name: stale_head_fence_epoch_cannot_commit
cases.expectation: Stale revision/ordering head, foreign fence, or changed epoch cannot commit; store state unchanged.

cases.name: cancellation_before_send_no_effect
cases.expectation: Cancelling before send leaves no provider effect; reconcile finds no receipt.

cases.name: cancellation_timeout_after_possible_send_scoped_uncertainty
cases.expectation: Timeout after possible send stays scoped uncertainty resolved only by receipt reconciliation; sibling scope keeps progressing.

cases.name: precommit_crash_reconciles_only_on_proven_absence
cases.expectation: Reconcile of a never-sent operation proves absence; only then may the same identity commit.

cases.name: postcommit_response_loss_recovers_original_receipt
cases.expectation: After commit, reconcile returns the original receipt; re-apply returns the identical receipt with no new effect.

cases.name: independent_scope_progress_under_delay_poison
cases.expectation: While one scope is stalled/unknown/poisoned at the seam, an independent scope commits with a valid receipt.

cases.name: bounded_capacity_with_protected_recovery
cases.expectation: Client-set and execution bounds are fixed closed values; serial generation refuses reserved writes; concurrent generation advertises the capability; drained uninstall required for profile change.

cases.name: migration_drain_accounts_every_operation
cases.expectation: Quiesced generation uninstall plus recovery-snapshot accounting covers every queued, in-flight, and unknown operation; normal writes excluded while drained.

cases.name: unknown_failed_migration_stays_fenced
cases.expectation: Incompatible generation migration stays fenced; only the accepted generation reopens the path.

cases.name: restart_reconstructs_state_without_orphans
cases.expectation: A fresh adapter generation on the same provider root reconstructs identical receipts; no orphaned reservations.

cases.name: session_process_root_cleanup
cases.expectation: Provider session, process binding, and isolated root clean up completely; primary and cleanup errors both retained.

cases.name: product_pulse_kernel_route_progress
cases.expectation: Product Pulse scenario through the admitted production EBP client route: independent-scope progress, cancellation/recovery, and receipt correctness with real EBP frames.

cases.name: source_proof_guard
cases.expectation: Guard rejects missing scenarios, forged results, erased ordering fields, fake overlap, oracle weakening, production edits, and unowned concurrent manifest changes.
